name: 海洋II上海站第三次版本
english_description: The in-game title is Ocean II — confirmed (via file-by-file comparison) to be a genuine sibling snapshot of hy2000 and hy2002 elsewhere in this collection, sharing roughly 9,600 and 10,253 files by path with each respectively: this is the third version snapshot deployed on the "Shanghai server" of the same ES2/Jin-Yong-themed "Ocean II" codebase, not an independently developed game. Its map and marriage system (d/marry/) match the rest of the family, spanning sects including Wudang, Mingjiao, Shaolin, Emei, Kunlun, and Peach Blossom Island.
